additional_contracts.normative_statement: The collision-avoidance sub-machine (CollisionAvoidance composite) must be reachable from the top-level root scope so that it can become active upon a collision-type event; the closed model must provide a root-level path into it distinct from its own internal default entry.
additional_contracts.quote: This sub-machine becomes active when a possible frontend collision, rear-end collision or collision with pedestrian is detected.
additional_contracts.reason: NL2 requires the sub-machine to become active (i.e., be entered) from its enclosing owner on a collision event. The exact source model routes CollisionDetection -> CollisionAvoidance via the 'Collision Mode Active' event (tr_0015 / transition:line:60), but the closed FCSTM only wires [*] -> InitialState at the root; CollisionDetection itself is never reached from root, so the entire activation chain into CollisionAvoidance is unreachable. This is a distinct global-reachability property from CollisionAvoidance's own internal default-entry defect (which is captured against the same base contract) because even a perfect internal default entry inside CollisionAvoidance cannot activate the composite if no root path reaches it at all.
additional_contracts.scope: Root-to-CollisionAvoidance reachability, distinct from CollisionAvoidance's own internal default-entry obligation

cardinality_bindings.basis: NL1 quote 'There are three region in this diagram'; exact_source_inventory states for CollisionAvoidance (line 11) and its six child states; fcstm_model.text CollisionAvoidance comment block listing '[PlantUML concurrent region 0]...region 1...region 2...region 3' and three '[PlantUML concurrent separator]' entries at source lines 12,16,20; working_contract source_trace region rows region:CollisionAvoidance:region:0..3 tracing 1:1 to source region separators.
cardinality_bindings.reason: NL1 explicitly states 'There are three region in this diagram', and the referenced diagram/sub-machine composite that is explicitly structured with PlantUML '--' separators is CollisionAvoidance. The fcstm_model text for CollisionAvoidance embeds an explicit region-projection comment enumerating 4 PlantUML-delimited region blocks (region 0 empty, region 1 = AutomaticBraking/BrakingComplete, region 2 = SteeringControl/SteeringComplete, region 3 = AlertSystem/AlertComplete), separated by 3 explicit concurrent separators at source lines 12/16/20. Region 0 is an empty leading partition with no states/transitions, so the diagram exhibits exactly three concurrent behavioral regions matching NL1's stated count, owned by the CollisionAvoidance composite. This is the correct scope binding under the contract-level owner rule because CollisionAvoidance is the exact composite explicitly partitioned by author-source separators, not a generic 'diagram' wrapper.

response.reason: This lens compared the six supplied atomic contracts against the exact closed FCSTM topology, source inventory, and deterministic facts to check contract completeness, containment/region structure, owner default-entry, transition-group correctness, and event-consumer coverage. Root ([*]->InitialState) is the only default entry at top level; CollisionDetection, CollisionAvoidance, and OperationalControls (each nested owner) have exact composite membership and no unconditional/default entry from the root scope, so they are unreachable, and their internal event consumers are declared but never reachable. CollisionAvoidance's own region topology is exact (3 PlantUML concurrent regions -> matches NL1/NL3 required count), so the cardinality/region_structure contracts are satisfied at the region-count level, but the owning composite is itself unreachable from root, which is captured as a derived reachability defect rather than rewriting the satisfied region-count contracts.

response.reason: This lens audits behavioral consequence: root reachability of CollisionDetection/CollisionAvoidance/OperationalControls composites, reachable event-consumer coverage for the three collision events, initial_entry from the enclosing owner, region structure, and the state_action progress obligation of the active collision-avoidance mode. The closed FCSTM (fcstm_model/inspection_equivalent_facts/verify_facts) shows a fundamental disconnect: the machine root has no outgoing transition to CollisionDetection, CollisionAvoidance, or OperationalControls, so none of those composites (nor their children) is reachable_from_initial. All 13 EVENT_CONSUMER_UNREACHABLE diagnostics and all corresponding verify_facts event-consumer checks are refuted for exactly this reason. This produces distinct candidates for NL2-INITENTRY-1 (owner-level entry from enclosing scope into the sub-machine is missing/broken), NL2-EVENTCOVER-1 (event consumer coverage for the three collision events is declared but unreachable), and a derived root-reachability contract for CollisionAvoidance (the active mode itself), since NL3's state_action obligation presupposes CollisionAvoidance is operationally reachable and active, which it is not. Region structure contracts (NL1-REGIONSTRUCT-1, NL3-REGIONSTRUCT-1) are satisfied structurally (CollisionAvoidance has 4 declared PlantUML concurrent regions, region 0 empty) so they are omitted here per lens priority on behavioral consequence.
